headline: OpenAI reports engineering-task gains and early industry workflows with AI models
summary: In a 3 November 2026 report, OpenAI described engineering workflows and reported a 0.875 BenchCAD 2.0 result for a newer internal model versus 0.594 for GPT-6 Astra at maximum effort. BenchCAD’s current leaderboard now lists the unreleased OpenAI model on a separate, provider-credited Codex custom-harness board, using the 2.0 scorer and estimating cost at about $38 per case. BenchCAD says custom-harness and standard 2.1 scores are not comparable; the 0.875 remains an OpenAI-linked result without task-level run data or independent reproduction. BenchCAD 2.0 covers 100 held-out cases across CAD parts, assemblies and PCB connectivity, not manufacturability or physical performance. OpenAI also describes early engineer-reviewed work with Chip Ganassi Racing and Mazda, without measured productivity or production outcomes.
